Worldwide

International billfish and IGFA slams

A billfish slam counts different kinds of billfish. The IGFA awards belong to individual anglers; crews also talk about boat slams.

05 TERMS

Billfish fantasy slam#

One angler catches any five eligible billfish species in one calendar day under IGFA rules.

Atlantic blue marlinPacific blue marlinBlack marlinWhite marlinStriped marlinAtlantic sailfishPacific sailfishSwordfishSpearfish
Where you’ll hear it +
EXAMPLE / International billfish and IGFA slams

“Five billfish species in one day is a fantasy slam.”

IGFA Grand Slam Clubs application ↗IGFA Grand Slam Clubs ↗

Billfish grand slam#

One angler catches any three eligible billfish species in one calendar day under IGFA rules.

Atlantic blue marlinPacific blue marlinBlack marlinWhite marlinStriped marlinAtlantic sailfishPacific sailfishSwordfishSpearfish

Also heard in Central America’s Pacific coast

Where you’ll hear it +
EXAMPLE / International billfish and IGFA slams

“Three different billfish today. That’s a grand slam.”

Central America’s Pacific coast: Three different billfish species caught in one day. Off Quepos, a usual combination is sailfish, blue marlin, and black or striped marlin.

IGFA Grand Slam Clubs ↗Billfish Grand Slam Costa Rica: What It Takes and When to Try ↗Costa Rica Fishing Calendar — Central America Fishing ↗

Billfish royal slam#

One angler catches all nine listed billfish categories over a lifetime under IGFA rules. Any spearfish species fills the spearfish place.

Atlantic blue marlinPacific blue marlinBlack marlinWhite marlinStriped marlinAtlantic sailfishPacific sailfishSwordfishSpearfish
Where you’ll hear it +
EXAMPLE / International billfish and IGFA slams

“I’m still working toward my lifetime billfish royal slam.”

IGFA Royal Slam Clubs ↗

Billfish super grand slam#

One angler catches any four eligible billfish species in one calendar day under IGFA rules.

Atlantic blue marlinPacific blue marlinBlack marlinWhite marlinStriped marlinAtlantic sailfishPacific sailfishSwordfishSpearfish

Also heard in Central America’s Pacific coast

Where you’ll hear it +
EXAMPLE / International billfish and IGFA slams

“Four billfish species for one angler. That’s some day.”

Central America’s Pacific coast: One angler catches four eligible billfish species in one calendar day under IGFA rules; sailfish plus blue, black, and striped marlin qualifies.
